sentences.text: Norolan Artisanlures Oy is a portfolio company registered on 2019-02-18 under the industry code 32300, manufacture of sports goods.
A funding round of EUR 600 000 is dated 2025-02-17 and three Business Finland decisions are on record, the largest EUR 360 610 for 2025.
The register shows share issues dated 2022-12-13 and 2026-04-27, and first sales on 2019-03-01.
On the radar's rules technology, business and investment readiness are all level 4.
For the fund the memo says watchlist because ocean impact reads Low and investment readiness reads Low, so no decision row matches.
